PLD 2023 Punjab Statutes 172
PLD 2023 Punjab Statutes 172
ACT XV OF 2023
PROVINCIAL MOTOR VEHICLES
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 2023
An Act to amend the Provincial Motor
Vehicles Ordinance, 1965
[Gazette of Punjab Extraordinary,
17th February, 2023]
No.
PAP/Legis-2(146)/2022/108, dated 17.2.2023.---The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Bill 2022, having been
passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on the 9th day of January 2023,
and assented to by the Governor of the Punjab on the 23rd day of January 2023,
is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
It
is necessary to amend the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 (XIX of
1965) for the purposes of registering and regulating the electric and hybrid
vehicles, and for the ancillary matters.
Be it enacted by Provincial Assembly of the Punjab as follows:
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be cited as the Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 2023.
(2) This
Act shall come into force at once.

Amendment of section 2 of Ordinance XIX of 1965

vehicles, and for the ancillary matters.
Be it enacted by Provincial Assembly of the Punjab as follows:
2. Amendment
of section 2 of Ordinance XIX of 1965.---In the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 (XIX of 1965), for
brevity referred to as 'the Ordinance', in section 2, in clause (23), for the
words "mechanically propelled vehicle", the expression "vehicle
propelled mechanically or electrically either partially or completely, and any
hybrid vehicle," shall be substituted.

3. Amendment
of section 25 of Ordinance XIX of 1965.---In the Ordinance, in section 25:
(a) in
subsection (1), after the word "prescribed", the words
"documents and" shall be added; and
(b) in
subsection (1), for the full stop at the end, a colon shall be substituted and
thereafter the following proviso shall be inserted:
"Provided
that application may also be submitted through the motor vehicle transaction
licensee licensed under the Punjab Motor Vehicle Transaction Licensees Act,
2015 (XXVII of 2015).".

4. Amendment
of section 30 of Ordinance XIX of 1965.---In the Ordinance, in section 30, for subsection (1), the following
shall be substituted:
"(1)
If a motor vehicle not required to be registered in the Province under section
29 is kept in that Province, the owner may apply to the registering authority
concerned for new registration mark by submitting the existing certificate of
registration and the number plates containing the registration mark issued by
the previous registering authority.".

Be it enacted by Provincial Assembly of the Punjab as follows:
5. Amendment
of section 32 of Ordinance XIX of 1965.---In the Ordinance, in section 32, after subsection (1d), following
subsections (1e) and (1f) shall be added:
"(1e)
A registering authority may, on its own motion or on the application of any
person, after giving the transferor and transferee an opportunity of making
representation, and for reasons to be recorded in writing, pass an order for
cancellation of transfer of a motor vehicle made under subsection (1) in case
such transfer has been made on the basis of false documents or information.
(1f)
The registering authority passing an order for cancellation of transfer of a
motor vehicle under subsection (1e) shall communicate such order to the
original registering authority.".

6. Amendment
of section 34 of Ordinance XIX of 1965.---In the Ordinance, in section 34:
(a) in
subsection (5), for the full stop at the end, a colon shall be substituted and
thereafter the following proviso shall be inserted:
"Provided
that any order for cancellation of registration under subsection (5) shall be
made in accordance with the procedure laid down in section 35 of this Ordinance.";
and
(b) after
subsection (6), the following subsection (7) shall be inserted:
"(7)
A motor vehicle shall not be deemed to be validly registered for the purposes
of section 25 of this Ordinance, after passing of a suspension order under this
section and no such vehicle shall be used in any public place until the order
for suspension is rescinded.".
